comment: Source read at commit f6cf8d6, the commit whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.0.1. The frequency parameter is configured as 2 to the power of the value in Hertz, -4 to 13 (NonlinearIntegrator.cpp:58). A very small random offset is added to the filter input on every sample (line 79) so that a bandpass-to-input patch can start oscillating from silence. The resonance CV attenuverter runs -2 to +2 and is displayed at half that, so its printed range matches the other attenuverters.
